text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, for this part of the story... I want 
it to feel like "A formidable foe 
appears!", but—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Aha! Wait a second, if I bring out that 
demon who appeared in Episode 13... Oh, 
ohooo~! Oh man, am I a genius or what?!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Paint it, world of Kiseki—"The Created 
Fantasy"! Once my brush starts moving, 
nothing can stop itttt!!
choice_data_list:

looking for you!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Huh? ...T-Trainer!? Whoa, how did it get 
so late already...?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I gave Kiseki a stern reprimand for 
getting completely carried away and 
forgetting about training.
